رَاجِنٌ That keeps to the tents, or houses; domesticated, familiar, or tame; (S, TA;) like دَاجِنٌ: (S:) applied in this sense to a bird: (TA:) and in like manner رَاجِنَةٌ applied to camels: (S, * TA:) and to a sheep or goat (شَاة), and a she-camel, that remains in [or at] the houses, or tents. (TA.) ―
-b2- And شَاةٌ رَاجِنٌ A sheep, or goat, confined, shut up, or kept close, and badly fed, so that it becomes lean. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
